name: EPIC 212335045
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 11.7 solar radii and 0.88 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212335045 (K2 campaign 6): PARAM radius (solar radii) 11.690641 (16th-84th percentiles 11.368428-12.169505), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 5,514 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.88 solar masses and 11.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,456 K at its surface.
